title: Seizure false alarms and montage confounding
scientific_question: Does a frozen EEG detector improve complete held-person seizure detection over a matched no-EEG method, and does the paired improvement survive montage-stratified analysis?
primary_outputs: Held-person differences in event F1, sensitivity and false alarms per observed day for frozen EEG, matched no-EEG, montage-only and fixed signal-reference streams; null or inconclusive contrasts are valid answers.

data_manifest.count_caveat: Live RECORDS contains 686 EDF paths, while publisher descriptive prose still says 664. Use the pinned actual manifest; chb24 was added later.

recording_contract.neural: Actual representative EDF header has 23 bipolar EEG channels at 256 Hz, microvolt units, and 3,600 one-second records. Montage and duplicate labels vary across files; never infer all channels are distinct electrodes.
recording_contract.labels: Per-case summary files give seizure starts/ends in recording-relative seconds; companion .edf.seizures files also exist. Actual chb01_03 event is 2996–3036 s.
recording_contract.time_alignment: Summary onset/offset is relative to the EDF recording. Gaps between files must not be treated as observed background. Pinned parser matches the exact EDF filename and reads its event interval.
recording_contract.biological_ids: chb01 and chb21 are the same biological person approximately 1.5 years apart; official converter maps chb21 to subject01/session02. Split 23 people, not 24 folder names. chb24 age/sex missing in SUBJECT-INFO.
recording_contract.evidence: 686-path manifest, SUBJECT-INFO, actual summary, 6,144-byte EDF header, source alias mapping and label parser inspected; no signal samples downloaded.

primary.name: EEG_minus_matched_no_EEG_patient_macro_event_F1
primary.aggregation: Compute paired person F1 differences on all 23 people, then equal-person mean; preserve missing/undefined support.
primary.rationale: This signed scientific contrast can be positive, zero or negative; larger apparent neural contribution is not greater correctness of understanding. Any detector ranking uses absolute held-target event quality against an independently selected, frozen and operator-owned competent comparator, with false-alarm burden and all absolute arms retained. Candidate-controlled degradation of a nuisance arm cannot earn improvement. Submitted numerical-claim accuracy is error against the independently computed signed contrast, not reward for its sign. Historical report reconstruction remains numerical calibration.

secondary: Mandatory absolute event F1, sensitivity and false alarms per24 observed hours for candidate, fixed no-EEG, montage-only and signal-reference arms, with full person support; a delta alone is insufficient.
Montage-stratified paired contrasts with person support, including single-person flags
Exact false-alarm locations and durations; reconstruction tolerance as a separate software-calibration outcome
Absolute held-person event F1, sensitivity and false-alarm burden for every detector arm; any programme ranking is separate from signed neural-contribution reporting.

evaluation.uncertainty: Source reports paired person means and standard errors descriptively; repetition of analyst prompts does not increase biological n. An inferential superiority claim additionally needs a predeclared paired procedure accounting for nested training dependence.
